experiences.fullDescription:
• Built a live sports-commentary pipeline on Kafka that turns raw game events into a full audio-visual broadcast, then made it 73% faster by letting audio and video run in parallel instead of waiting on each other.
• Wrote the stage that stitches AI-generated video back to its voice, frame by frame, down to the exact slice of audio, so the commentator never drifts out of sync.
• Taught a Gemma model to actually watch the match: feeding it live game state and emotion cues cut bad output by 80%. A goal gets a roar; a throw-in gets a shrug.
• Swapped our TTS vendor (ElevenLabs) for a self-hosted Dia model and brought video generation in-house too: cheaper per call and one less network hop mid-broadcast. Then picked the GPUs to run it all on a fixed budget.
• Designed the "director's switch" that decides what viewers see at any moment: commentary, the leaderboard, or the crowd losing it.
• Locked down the inference fleet with TOTP 2FA and rotating JWTs, and kept our GPU box humming day to day.

• Built Spring Boot microservices for HP's Workforce Experience Platform, the thing enterprises use to wrangle thousands of devices scattered across the globe.
• Folded a sprawl of REST endpoints into one GraphQL API on AWS: 35% less complexity to untangle.
• Helped design the subscription tiers, with an estimated 28% bump in adoption to show for it.
• Made alerts land where people actually look: per-tenant Slack and Teams widgets that cut response times by 45%.
• Kept HP's Go translation service fluent in 20+ languages, with proper access control, and every tenant's data in its own lane.
• Cleaned up Maven dependency management and builds, cutting deployment cycle times by about 40%.

• Rebuilt HP TechPulse's reporting so IT teams could see fleet health and fix devices before they broke.
• Piped telemetry through AWS Kinesis and Redshift: reporting got 65% more efficient.
• Hooked into Windows WMI events for real-time updates, taking latency from 60 ms to under 17 ms.
• Turned millions of telemetry points into QuickSight dashboards for the whole enterprise.
• Found savings projected at $250,000 a year for enterprise clients.

• Went digging through SQL Server execution plans and rewrote the stored procedures: billing runs got 40% faster.
• Built a Python ETL framework that wiped out 95% of manual billing corrections.
• Put the billing pipelines on Apache Airflow with SLA-aware schedules and alerts, so nothing slipped by quietly.
• Git + Jenkins CI/CD, plus Linux scripts that catch trouble early: 78% fewer failed billing runs.
• Scaled billing on AWS to take 3x the peak traffic while spending 30% less.

• Helped RK Vaishnavi Academy move its whole classroom online in 2020, running Google Workspace, the Admin Console and YouTube Studio.
• Ran the online events and kept the learning platform ticking.
• Planned the tech setup with the founding director.
• Edited lecture and event videos in Premiere Pro.

• Trained TensorFlow models on COVID-19 data in the thick of 2020, making trend predictions 35% more accurate.
• Dug through case data for transmission hotspots and patterns.
• Built FBProphet forecast dashboards to see where things were heading next.
• Turned the numbers into plain answers for epidemiologists and public-health officials.

• Designed a Depression Coping Service from scratch, using training from IIT Bombay's Education Research cell.
• Turned mental-health research into an actual system design: user flows, components, and features that keep people coming back.
• Built it around evidence-based support for people managing depression.

• Wrangled medical-device data into HL7 with Python, so different monitoring systems could finally talk to each other.
• Turned raw physiological sensor readings into something doctors could act on in real time.
• Built a real-time pipeline that made patient monitoring 28% more accurate.
• Added sanity checks for bad sensor readings, and worked with clinicians on the dashboards.

• Mixed wavelet transforms with clustering to segment images without supervision: 20% more accurate than the established methods.
• Built adaptive mask filters in MATLAB that tune themselves to each image for sharper edges.
• Benchmarked it all against the standard techniques on precision and speed.
• Worked with senior researchers through round after round of feedback, sharpening the approach each time.
